glosses: used as a stand-in for various particles to mimic dialectal speech
partial equivalent of the "ni" and "he" particles in standard Japanese

exampleTranslations.1: And then I breathe a sigh from melancholy in being unable to do anything about it.
exampleTranslations.2: Do your best and don't worry.
exampleTranslations.3: But, I have to take my mother.
